awards.name: CSC National High-Level University Graduate Program (国家建设高水平大学公派研究生项目)
awards.description: China Scholarship Council flagship outbound graduate program for 2026. Selection categories are PhD study abroad (36–48 months) and joint PhD training (6–24 months). Living stipend + one round-trip airfare; tuition is NOT covered. Applicants need foreign PhD offer/invitation plus tuition waiver or external tuition funding. Mainland PRC nationals without foreign permanent residency.
awards.eligibility: PRC citizens without foreign permanent residency; age ≤35 (born after 1990-01-01); language conditions per CSC guide. 2026 categories do NOT include standalone overseas master's. Masters may still appear under other CSC channels (e.g. international-organization talent program).
awards.amount: Living stipend for funded period + one round-trip international airfare; no tuition (verbatim from 2026 project guide mirrors)
awards.deadline: Online application 2026-03-10 00:00 – 2026-04-01 14:00 Beijing time; results ~end of May 2026; qualification valid through 2027-12-31
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/csc-high-level-phd.md — Critical for Fall 2027 PhD CS paths; NOT a general US MBA/terminal MS fund. Since ~2019 CSC no longer runs a broad national overseas-master's slot under this project.

sources.label: Donghua Univ mirror — 2026 High-Level Graduate Program Guide

awards.name: CSC International Organization Talent Development Program (国际组织后备人才培养项目)
awards.description: CSC program that DOES select overseas master's (12–24 months) and joint master's (3–12 months) for students aiming at international-organization careers. Funding: airfare + living stipend; tuition support available for full overseas master's (degree-seeking). CSC cooperation channels listed for Sciences Po Paris, UNU-MERIT, IE University Spain — US destinations mainly via university cooperation channels.
awards.eligibility: PRC; excellent current master's students at Chinese universities with strong IO career intent; age ≤28 (born after 1997-01-01); must already hold foreign admit/invitation. Post-study: seek IO internship/employment ≥6 months within one year. Unit recommendation required — CSC does not take direct individual applications for unit channel.
awards.amount: Airfare + living stipend for funded period; tuition may be funded for degree master's (per 2026 guide)
awards.deadline: Person applications 2026 batch 1: Apr 1–10 14:00; batch 2: Sep 1–10 14:00 Beijing time. Results Jun / Nov 2026. Qualification valid through 2027-12-31
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/csc-io-talent-masters.md — Narrow career fit (IO track), not general CS/MBA. Include because it is one of the few verified CSC master's outbound routes for 2026.

sources.label: CQNU mirror — 2026 IO Talent Program Guide

awards.name: CSC Americas–Oceania Bilateral / Cooperative Scholarships (美大地区中外合作奖学金)
awards.description: 2026 CSC launched 42 Americas–Oceania cooperative scholarship projects. Public university mirrors list partners in Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Mexico — predominantly PhD (and some visiting/postdoc). No verified US master's project in the published 42-project detail tables reviewed for this card.
awards.eligibility: PRC applicants via home university recommendation; must obtain foreign admit/invitation and partner nomination. Degree level and country are project-specific.
awards.amount: Per individual partner project guide (not uniform); typically stipend/fees per CSC–partner agreement
awards.deadline: Online application 2026-03-10 00:00 – 2026-04-01 14:00 Beijing time; dispatch by end of 2027-12
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/csc-americas-oceania-coop.md — Keep on watchlist for US partners; Batch-1 finding = NO confirmed US terminal MS/MBA slot in the 42-project public list. Do not treat as a general US master's scholarship.

awards.name: CSC National Outstanding Self-Financed Students Scholarship (国家优秀自费留学生奖学金)
awards.description: One-time merit award for outstanding PRC citizens already studying abroad on self-financed status. 2026–27 cycle: Class A for current PhD year-2+ graduating after 2027-06-30 ($6,000; exceptional $10,000); Class B for returning PhD graduates/postdocs in a defined window ($10,000).
awards.eligibility: PRC passport, no foreign permanent residency; PhD-focused (not new master's applicants). Prior recipients or current/past CSC-funded students ineligible. Apply via CSC system + local Chinese embassy/consulate education office.
awards.amount: Class A USD 6,000 (exceptional USD 10,000); Class B USD 10,000 — one-time
awards.deadline: Online 2026-11-23 00:00 – 2026-12-04 23:59 Beijing time (system https://yxzfs.csc.edu.cn/). US-district local notices for 2026–27 may lag; watch embassy education pages.
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/csc-outstanding-self-financed.md — Useful mid-PhD / return bonus — not funding to start Fall 2027 MS/MBA. Included for PRC CS PhD pipeline completeness.

awards.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
awards.scope: Stanford full-time graduate degrees (MBA, MS, PhD, and others listed)
awards.state: Closed for 2027 cohort · next opens summer 2027 for 2028
awards.description: Stanford multidisciplinary graduate fellowship open to citizens/residents of all countries. Covers tuition and associated fees, living/academic stipend, annual travel stipend, and one-time relocation stipend for up to three years (degree-dependent; MA/MBA/MS typically up to six academic quarters).
awards.eligibility: No citizenship restriction (PRC passport holders eligible). Must apply concurrently to KHS and an eligible full-time Stanford graduate program (or meet listed current-student/deferral paths). First bachelor's earned Jan 2020 or later for 2027 cohort. MBA applicants must use Round 1.
awards.amount: Tuition + fees fellowship; living/academic stipend; annual economy travel stipend; one-time relocation stipend (exact stipend dollars not published on funding page — unclear)
awards.deadline: 2027 cohort: Oct 6, 2026 1:00pm PT (CLOSED). Stanford degree deadline earlier of program KHS deadline or Dec 1, 2026. 2028 cohort application opens summer 2027.
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/knight-hennessy.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/knight-hennessy.md — Strong dual-use for Stanford MBA and CS MS/PhD. 2027 cycle already closed as of asOf date.

awards.name: AAUW International Fellowships (STEM master's/doctorate)
awards.scope: Accredited U.S. STEM graduate programs (master's or first doctorate)
awards.description: AAUW awards for women who are non-U.S. citizens/permanent residents pursuing full-time STEM master's or academic/professional doctorate in the U.S. (CS and related STEM fields listed).
awards.eligibility: Must identify as a woman; non-U.S. citizen and not U.S. permanent resident; admitted or enrolled in first master's or doctorate in STEM at time of application; CGPA ≥3.5/4.0 on highest degree; program start on/before Sep 15, 2027 and complete on/after Apr 30, 2028. MBA not STEM — typically ineligible unless program is STEM-classified.
awards.amount: USD 20,000 (master's) or USD 25,000 (doctorate) stipend for fellowship term (disbursed in two payments)
awards.deadline: Applications open Aug 17, 2026 9:00am ET; close Sep 17, 2026 5:00pm ET (CLOSED for 2027–28). Award notice Mar 2027.
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/aauw-international.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/aauw-international.md — CS master's/PhD fit; not general MBA.

awards.name: P.E.O. International Peace Scholarship (IPS)
awards.scope: Graduate study at accredited U.S. or Canada colleges/universities
awards.description: Need-based scholarship for international women pursuing graduate study in the U.S. or Canada. Not intended to cover all expenses; applicant must show additional resources.
awards.eligibility: Woman outside the U.S. and Canada seeking an advanced degree in the U.S. or Canada; intends to return home to make positive impact; full year of formal coursework remaining and enrolled/in residence for entire school year. Not for U.S./Canada citizens or permanent residents. Doctoral students on dissertation-only not eligible as first-time applicants. Online-only courses ineligible.
awards.amount: Maximum USD 12,500; lesser amounts by need (verbatim IPS page)
awards.deadline: Eligibility/application period Sep 15 – Dec 15 each year; awards announced in May
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/peo-ips.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/peo-ips.md — Postgrad-eligible need-based path for PRC women; MS CS and MBA both advanced degrees.

awards.name: Harvard Business School MBA Need-Based Scholarships
awards.description: HBS awards need-based scholarships to both domestic and international MBA students. Admission is merit-based; aid is need-based via standardized formula (income, assets, socioeconomic background, undergrad debt).
awards.eligibility: Admitted HBS MBA students; international students eligible (page states need-based scholarships for domestic and international). Apply only after admission (MBA Financial Aid Application + Certification of Finances for non-US citizens/PRs).
awards.amount: Awards range USD 2,000–87,000 per year; ~50% of students receive need-based scholarships; average ~USD 100,000 over two years (verbatim HBS page)
awards.deadline: Post-admission; follow HBS MBA Financial Aid calendar (unclear exact Fall 2027 dates on page)
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/hbs-need.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/hbs-need.md — Explicit international inclusion; PRC passport holders not excluded by citizenship language.

awards.name: Stanford GSB MBA Need-Based Fellowships
awards.description: Stanford GSB need-based fellowships (non-repayable) for MBA students. Page states all MBA students regardless of citizenship are eligible for financial aid; fellowships based solely on demonstrated need.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Stanford MBA students of any citizenship (verbatim: all MBA students regardless of citizenship eligible for financial aid). Employer sponsorship typically makes students ineligible for GSB fellowships.
awards.amount: Average fellowship ~USD 47,000 per year or ~USD 94,000 total (verbatim Types of Aid page); ~half of MBA students receive fellowship funds
awards.deadline: Post-admission financial aid process (unclear exact Fall 2027 deadlines on page)

awards.name: Michigan Ross Full-Time MBA Merit Scholarships
awards.description: Ross considers all full-time MBA applicants for admission scholarships. Page explicitly states this applies to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and international students. No separate application.
awards.eligibility: All full-time MBA admits including international students (verbatim). Awards based on academic ability, professional/personal achievements, and community contribution. Renewable for both years subject to good academic standing.
awards.amount: USD 10,000 to full tuition (verbatim scholarships page)
awards.deadline: Automatic with admission decision; no separate deadline
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/ross-merit.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/ross-merit.md — Explicit international language; PRC eligible under intl clause.

awards.name: Duke Fuqua Daytime MBA Merit Scholarships
awards.description: Fuqua International Student Financial Aid FAQ: every admitted applicant is considered for a merit scholarship. Awards for the 2-year MBA duration; range partial to full tuition. Only form of gift assistance from Fuqua (aside from limited invited second-year awards).
awards.eligibility: Every admitted Daytime MBA applicant considered (FAQ under International Students). Criteria: prior academic achievement, leadership, community involvement, extracurriculars, professional accomplishments. No citizenship exclusion stated on FAQ.
awards.amount: Partial tuition to full tuition for 2 years (verbatim FAQ); exact dollar bands unclear
awards.deadline: Automatic with admission; no separate application
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/fuqua-merit.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/fuqua-merit.md — On international FAQ page; treat as PRC-welcome via intl consideration.

awards.name: ByteDance Scholarship (字节跳动奖学金)
awards.scope: Enrolled students at universities worldwide (AI/CS/basic sciences)
awards.description: Company research prize for students enrolled at global universities in AI/CS/basic sciences. First global open year. Cash research award (not tuition-to-matriculate for US study). Dual-use for PRC students already at or soon at US programs who graduate Jun 2027 or later.
awards.eligibility: Global university enrolled students; graduation Jun 2027 or later; AI, CS, basic sciences (examples: foundation models, CV, speech, ML systems, AI for Science, embodied AI). Bachelor's/master's/PhD all stages welcome. Not a degree-entry scholarship.
awards.amount: CNY 200,000 research award to student + CNY 100,000 to advisor (non-Mainland China: equivalent currency)
awards.deadline: Online applications May–Jun; deadline Jun 26, 2026 24:00; results Nov 2026
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/bytedance-scholarship.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/bytedance-scholarship.md — NOT Alibaba/Tencent/Huawei overseas-study tuition fund. No verified Alibaba/Tencent/Huawei degree-abroad scholarship found on official pages.

awards.name: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship (GRF)
awards.scope: PhD in EECS/math/physics/statistics at accredited research institutions (US and listed countries)
awards.description: Jane Street fellowship for exceptional PhD students (or students committed to start PhD Fall 2027) in EECS, mathematics, physics, or statistics. International students explicitly encouraged.
awards.eligibility: At least one year remaining in PhD (or committed to commence PhD Fall 2027) in listed fields; full-time at accredited research institution in US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, or Singapore. International students eligible and encouraged. Not for MBA/terminal MS.
awards.amount: Full tuition and fees for upcoming academic year + USD 50,000 living stipend; finalists USD 5,000
awards.deadline: Student applications Nov 13, 2026 AoE; recommendation letters Dec 1, 2026 AoE; notifications February
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/jane-street-grf.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/jane-street-grf.md — PhD CS pipeline; not MS/MBA entry funding.

awards.name: Meta Research PhD Fellowship
awards.scope: Full-time PhD students at accredited universities (research areas listed by Meta)
awards.description: Meta Research PhD Fellowship for students in any PhD year whose research aligns with Meta's listed fellowship areas. Winners receive two years of paid tuition and fees, annual stipend, Fellowship Summit visit, and Meta researcher engagement.
awards.eligibility: Full-time PhD student at accredited university; any PhD year; research must match Meta's listed areas for the cycle. Open to diverse backgrounds; citizenship not restricted on main portal text. Prior Facebook/Meta grant may disqualify (per third-party summaries — re-verify FAQ).
awards.amount: Two years tuition and fees + USD 42,000 annual stipend for living and conference travel (verbatim Meta application portal)
awards.deadline: Application opens Aug 3; closes Sep 20; reference letters Oct 6; winners notified ~Jan 18 (year in portal timeline; confirm current cycle year on portal)
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/meta-phd.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/meta-phd.md — PhD only. Overlaps conceptually with SCH-042/043/059 family; NEW award not previously catalogued in HK/TW set.

awards.name: Yale SOM MBA Scholarships (Dean's and general grant aid)
awards.description: Yale SOM awards scholarships post-admission via a short supplemental application; only candidates who complete it are considered. Dean's Scholarships are the bulk of grants. Named country awards (India, Africa, Mexico) are separate; Dean's/general pool does not exclude PRC nationals on the page.
awards.eligibility: Admitted full-time MBA students who complete the scholarship application. Country-specific named awards (Global Leaders from India; Yale Africa Impact; Yale-FUNED Mexico) do NOT apply to PRC. Forté/ROMBA/Consortium tracks overlap existing SCH ids — flag only.
awards.amount: Unclear individual Dean's amounts; >USD 7.8M awarded to incoming MBA students in 2024; median scholarship Class of 2027 USD 65K (affording page). Aspire Fellowships USD 60,000 to full tuition/fees (Class of 2027 initiative).
awards.deadline: Post-admission supplemental application (dates provided in admit portal — unclear on public page)
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/yale-som.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/yale-som.md — PRC eligible for Dean's/general; not for India/Africa/Mexico named awards.

awards.name: CSC Innovative Talent International Cooperation Program (创新型人才国际合作培养项目)
awards.scope: Project-based outbound (PhD primary; limited master's if project approved)
awards.description: CSC 'project-system' program: Chinese universities/institutes win multi-year projects, then select students. Main categories are PhD, joint PhD, postdoc, visiting. Units may send a small number of degree master's (12–24 months) or joint master's (3–12 months) if the approved project includes them. Tuition support possible for some urgently needed master's/PhD fields per project notice. US destinations only if the approved project lists US partners.
awards.eligibility: PRC citizen, no foreign PR; must be selected by a Chinese project unit that has an approved CSC innovative-talent project — CSC does not take direct individual applications. Master's category: excellent graduating undergrads at the unit (or current master's if dual-master project). Age ≤35 (born after 1990-01-01). Foreign admit/invitation required. Cannot personally pay tuition under this program.
awards.amount: Round-trip airfare + living stipend per national standards; tuition only if project notice funds it (unclear per project)
awards.deadline: 2026 person batches: Mar 1–11 14:00; Jun 1–11 14:00; Sep 1–11 14:00 Beijing time. Qualification valid through 2027-12-31.
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/csc-innovative-talent.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/csc-innovative-talent.md — Rare CSC master's path IF home university has US-partner project. Check unit project list; not a general open master's scholarship.

awards.name: Margaret McNamara Education Grants (MMEG) — US-Canada Program
awards.scope: Women from eligible countries enrolled full-time in U.S./Canada in-person programs
awards.description: Education grants for self-identifying women from World Bank–classified eligible countries (China listed under upper-middle-income). US-Canada program for students already enrolled full-time with valid student visa.
awards.eligibility: Woman ≥25 at deadline; national of eligible country (China listed); registered/enrolled (not merely admitted) in accredited in-person program; continue ≥1 semester after April award; graduate within 3 years of award; not US/Canada citizen or PR; not related to WBG/IMF/IDB staff. Certificate/undergrad/grad/postdoc welcome per FAQ.
awards.amount: Up to USD 18,000 for US-Canada program (FAQ; amounts may vary with funding availability)
awards.deadline: Sep 15 – Jan 15 11:59pm ET annually; results announced April; funds May–Jun
awards.note: aid-cn/opportunities/mmeg-us-canada.md — 04-scholarships/opportunities/mmeg-us-canada.md — Enrolled students only (not for applicants still in China pre-enrollment).
